senses.gloss: f. (נְטִי) inclining (the ear &c.), favor.—בעי מ׳ to ask a favor, beg.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 11:8">Targ. Y. Ex. XI, 8</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 72:12">Targ. Ps. LXXII, 12</cite>.—
Yoma 87ᵃ (in Hebr. diction.) המבקש מ׳ וכ׳ he who begs his neighbor (to forgive him).—במ׳, במָטוּתָא (cmp. בָּעוּ) I pray.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 43:20">Targ. Y. Gen. XLIII, 20</cite>.

<cite ref="Yoma 72b">Yoma 72ᵇ</cite> <he>במ׳ מיניכו</he> I beg of you.
